title: Concept: Keycloak administration console disclosed
description: The Keycloak administration console is served at this endpoint, so the identity-provider management interface is reachable.
applicability: Responses served by a Keycloak deployment.
risk: The console is the entry point to every realm and client registration, and a default admin account left enabled there is a common finding; MEDIUM because the page alone does not prove a login is possible.
